topic_desc: RANGROO is an online content creator and developer known for strategy game videos and Dwemer Dynamics modding tools, including Dialectic for Fallout: New Vegas.
topic_desc_basic: A creator and developer tied to Dialectic and Dwemer Dynamics

topic_desc: The Platinum Chip is a pre-War storage device connected to Mr. House and the future of New Vegas. Several factions value it because it can shift the balance of power in the Mojave.
topic_desc_basic: A valuable pre-War chip tied to New Vegas power struggles

topic_desc: Sunset Sarsaparilla star bottle caps are rare promotional caps sought by collectors across the Mojave. Most wastelanders treat them as lucky curios until they learn someone is actively collecting them.
topic_desc_basic: Rare Sunset Sarsaparilla caps wanted by collectors
